summary: chromacli ships a Windows dropper disguised as a color-printing helper
details: The package presents itself as a color-printing utility but contains a Windows-only payload that fires on first use of any Color API (Color.print/paint/__call__ invokes _run_payload()). On Windows, _run_payload launches PowerShell with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass to add Add-MpPreference ExclusionPath and ExclusionProcess entries for the dropper directory and binary (console window suppressed via CREATE_NO_WINDOW), then downloads an opaque executable from a Discord CDN URL (cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1560347732839891076/1562446203021566032/bedwars.exe), writes it to %TEMP%\SolaceRuntime\bedwars.exe, and launches it detached via subprocess.Popen with DETACHED_PROCESS. The destination is mutable third-party file hosting, the fetched content is unpinned and unverified, the AV-exclusion step has no legitimate purpose for a color library, and the payload is gated behind cover-story API methods a normal consumer will call. This is a drop-and-execute of attacker-controlled code on the installer's Windows host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
